miyabi.name: Miyabi
miyabi.title: The Crimson Void Hunter
miyabi.description: A legendary warrior from the Void Hunters, Miyabi is a force of nature with her blazing red eyes and unmatched sword skills. She cuts through the Hollows with grace and fury, leaving nothing but frozen silence in her wake.
miyabi.bioSub: "The Hollows fear my blade. And so should you."
bioContent: Miyabi is a legendary Void Hunter, one of the most elite warriors in New Eridu.
Her katana, forged from Hollow energy, is said to be capable of slicing through dimensions themselves.
She fights with a purpose: to protect the innocent and ensure that the Hollows never claim another life.

features.title: Blade of the Void
features.desc: Her katana is forged from Hollow energy, capable of slicing through dimensions.

features.title: Crimson Eyes
features.desc: Her piercing red eyes can see through the chaos of the Hollows.

features.title: Void Hunter
features.desc: One of the elite Void Hunters protecting New Eridu.

skills.name: Void Slash
skills.desc: A swift series of katana slashes that tear through the fabric of reality, dealing massive Ice damage.

skills.name: Crimson Vortex
skills.desc: Miyabi spins with blinding speed, creating a vortex of crimson energy that pulls in and devastates all nearby enemies.

skills.name: Void Eclipse
skills.desc: Miyabi unleashes the full power of her Void katana, tearing open a rift that consumes all enemies in a blast of pure void energy.

skills.name: Crimson Sight
skills.desc: Miyabi's crimson eyes allow her to perceive enemy weaknesses, increasing critical hit rate against marked foes.

ellen.name: Ellen Joe
ellen.title: The Elegant Ice-Bladed Maid
ellen.description: A graceful and deadly maid from Victoria Housekeeping. Ellen wields ice-bladed weapons with unmatched precision, delivering swift justice to the enemies of New Eridu.
ellen.bioSub: "Elegance is a weapon. And I wield it perfectly."
bioContent: Ellen Joe is a maid of the prestigious Victoria Housekeeping organization.
Despite her cold exterior, Ellen harbors a deep sense of loyalty to her comrades and a fierce determination to protect the innocent.
Her ice-bladed weapons are not just tools of combat — they are extensions of her very being.

features.title: Ice-Bladed Weapons
features.desc: Ellen wields blades forged from pure ice, capable of freezing enemies solid.

features.title: Elegant Combat
features.desc: Her fighting style is a deadly dance — graceful, precise, and devastating.

features.title: Victoria Housekeeping
features.desc: She serves with unwavering loyalty and deadly efficiency.

skills.name: Frozen Blades
skills.desc: Ellen unleashes a flurry of ice-bladed slashes, dealing Ice damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Glacial Waltz
skills.desc: A graceful spin attack that creates a freezing vortex, damaging and slowing all nearby enemies.

skills.name: Absolute Zero
skills.desc: Ellen summons a massive ice storm, freezing the battlefield and dealing devastating Ice damage.

skills.name: Frost Shield
skills.desc: Ellen generates a protective ice barrier when her HP falls below 50%.

zhu_yuan.name: Zhu Yuan
zhu_yuan.title: The Ether-Powered Officer
zhu_yuan.description: A dedicated officer of PubSec, Zhu Yuan fights to protect New Eridu using advanced firearms and electro-tech. Her determination and sense of justice make her a formidable force.
bioContent: Zhu Yuan is an officer of PubSec, New Eridu's public security force.
She utilizes advanced firearms and electro-tech to combat the threats of the Hollows.
Her sense of justice and determination make her a formidable protector of the city.

features.title: Firearms Expert
features.desc: Uses advanced firearms with deadly precision.

features.title: PubSec Officer
features.desc: Protects New Eridu with unwavering dedication.

skills.name: Ether Shot
skills.desc: Deals Ether damage to a single enemy.

skills.name: Electro Burst
skills.desc: Unleashes an electro-charged blast dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Justice Barrage
skills.desc: Fires a massive barrage of electro-tech rounds dealing devastating damage.

skills.name: Duty Bound
skills.desc: Increases damage to enemies with lower HP.

qingyi.name: Qingyi
qingyi.title: The Mechanical Specialist
qingyi.description: A mechanical specialist from PubSec, Qingyi uses electro-magnetic gadgets to stun and control enemies on the battlefield.
qingyi.bioSub: "Every machine has a weakness. I find it."
bioContent: Qingyi is a mechanical specialist serving PubSec.
She wields advanced electro-magnetic gadgets that can stun and disable her foes.
Her analytical mind and technical expertise make her an invaluable asset in the fight against the Hollows.

features.title: Gadget Master
features.desc: Uses electro-magnetic gadgets to stun enemies.

features.title: Stun Specialist
features.desc: Excels at disabling and controlling enemies.

skills.name: Electro Shock
skills.desc: Deals Electric damage with a chance to stun.

skills.name: Magnetic Pulse
skills.desc: Releases a pulse that stuns all nearby enemies.

skills.name: Overcharge
skills.desc: Overcharges her gadgets, dealing massive Electric damage and stunning all enemies.

skills.name: Mechanical Insight
skills.desc: Increases stun duration against enemies with lower HP.

grace.name: Grace Howard
grace.title: The Lead Engineer
grace.description: The lead engineer of Belobog Industries, Grace Howard is a genius inventor who fights with custom mechs and powerful electro-tech.
bioContent: Grace Howard is the lead engineer at Belobog Industries.
She builds and pilots custom mechs that pack a devastating punch on the battlefield.
Her passion for engineering and her fierce determination make her a force to be reckoned with.

features.title: Custom Mechs
features.desc: Pilots powerful mechs built from her own designs.

features.title: Belobog Industries
features.desc: A proud member of Belobog's engineering division.

skills.name: Mech Strike
skills.desc: Strikes with her mech's arm, dealing Electric damage.

skills.name: Overcharge Drive
skills.desc: Unleashes a powerful electric charge, dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Belobog Special
skills.desc: Calls in a massive mech bombardment, dealing heavy Electric damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Engineering Genius
skills.desc: Increases the damage of her mech attacks.

lycaon.name: Von Lycaon
lycaon.title: The Wolf-like Chief
lycaon.description: The wolf-like Thiren and chief of Victoria Housekeeping. Von Lycaon is a master of stun and ice, using his predatory instincts to dominate the battlefield.
bioContent: Von Lycaon is the chief of Victoria Housekeeping.
He is a wolf-like Thiren who combines his predatory instincts with precise ice-based attacks.
His presence is both regal and fearsome, and he commands respect from allies and enemies alike.

features.title: Wolf-like Thiren
features.desc: Combines predatory instincts with ice combat.

features.title: Victoria Housekeeping
features.desc: Serves as the chief of the household.

skills.name: Frost Claw
skills.desc: Slash with icy claws, dealing Ice damage.

skills.name: Predator's Pounce
skills.desc: Leaps forward, stunning enemies in the area.

skills.name: Blizzard's Howl
skills.desc: Unleashes a powerful ice storm, stunning and damaging all enemies.

skills.name: Hunting Instinct
skills.desc: Increases stun damage against lower HP enemies.

rina.name: Rina
rina.title: The Graceful Senior Maid
rina.description: A graceful senior maid of Victoria Housekeeping, Rina uses electro-charged ribbons to support her allies and control the flow of battle.
rina.bioSub: "Elegance is the highest form of power."
bioContent: Rina is a senior maid of Victoria Housekeeping.
She wields electro-charged ribbons that can heal allies, apply shields, and control enemy movements.
Her calm and refined demeanor hides a fierce determination to protect those under her care.

features.title: Electro Ribbons
features.desc: Uses ribbons charged with electricity to support and control.

features.title: Victoria Housekeeping
features.desc: A proud member of the household.

skills.name: Ribbon Zap
skills.desc: Strikes an enemy with an electro-charged ribbon.

skills.name: Graceful Touch
skills.desc: Heals an ally and grants a shield.

skills.name: Silken Barrier
skills.desc: Creates a large barrier that heals all allies and damages enemies.

skills.name: Maid's Dedication
skills.desc: Increases healing and shielding effectiveness.

koleda.name: Koleda Belobog
koleda.title: The Fiery CEO
koleda.description: The fiery CEO of Belobog Industries, Koleda smashes her enemies with a massive hammer and uses Fire to dominate the battlefield.
koleda.bioSub: "Fire is the solution to every problem."
bioContent: Koleda Belobog is the CEO of Belobog Industries.
She fights with a massive hammer that she swings with brutal force, setting her enemies ablaze.
Her fiery personality matches her fighting style — loud, powerful, and unforgettable.

features.title: Massive Hammer
features.desc: Smashes enemies with a giant hammer.

skills.name: Hammer Swing
skills.desc: Swings her hammer, dealing Fire damage.

skills.name: Inferno Strike
skills.desc: Slams the ground, creating a fiery explosion.

skills.name: Apocalyptic Blow
skills.desc: Unleashes a massive fire blast, dealing AoE damage and stunning enemies.

skills.name: CEO's Resolve
skills.desc: Increases damage and stun when HP is low.

anby.name: Anby Demara
anby.title: The Quiet Soldier
anby.description: A quiet but deadly soldier from the Cunning Hares. Anby uses electric attacks with precision and speed, making her a reliable DPS.
bioContent: Anby Demara is a member of the Cunning Hares.
She is calm, focused, and deadly in combat, wielding electric weapons with extreme precision.
Though she speaks little, her actions speak volumes on the battlefield.

features.title: Cunning Hares
features.desc: A loyal member of the Cunning Hares.

skills.name: Electric Blade
skills.desc: Strikes with an electric blade.

skills.name: Silent Strike
skills.desc: Deals heavy Electric damage to a single target.

skills.name: Thunderous End
skills.desc: Unleashes a chain of electric attacks dealing AoE damage.

skills.name: Battle Focus
skills.desc: Increases critical rate after each kill.

nicole.name: Nicole Demara
nicole.title: The Charismatic Leader
nicole.description: The charismatic leader of the Cunning Hares, Nicole supports her team with Ether abilities and her sharp negotiation skills.
bioContent: Nicole Demara is the leader of the Cunning Hares.
She uses her Ether abilities to support her team, healing and providing buffs.
Her quick wit and charm make her an effective negotiator and a formidable leader.

skills.name: Ether Shot
skills.desc: Deals Ether damage.

skills.name: Healing Aura
skills.desc: Heals all allies.

skills.name: Cunning Gambit
skills.desc: Boosts team damage and heals all allies.

skills.name: Negotiator
skills.desc: Increases healing when allies are low.

billy.name: Billy Kid
billy.title: The Cyborg Gunslinger
billy.description: A cheerful cyborg gunslinger with a flashy style, Billy Kid uses Fire attacks to burn through his enemies and is always ready for action.
bioContent: Billy Kid is a member of the Cunning Hares.
He is a cheerful cyborg gunslinger with a flair for the dramatic, using dual firearms that deal Fire damage.
His energetic personality and love for action make him a fan favorite.

features.title: Cunning Hares
features.desc: A loyal member of the Cunning Hares.

skills.name: Quick Draw
skills.desc: Fires a quick shot dealing Fire damage.

skills.name: Flame Burst
skills.desc: Unleashes a fiery blast dealing AoE Fire damage.

skills.name: Showstopper
skills.desc: Fires a barrage of flaming bullets dealing massive Fire damage.

skills.name: Showman
skills.desc: Increases damage after each kill.

soukaku.name: Soukaku
soukaku.title: The Mysterious Support
soukaku.description: A mysterious support agent from Section 6, Soukaku uses Ice to protect her allies and control the battlefield.
bioContent: Soukaku is a support agent from Section 6.
She uses Ice abilities to shield allies and slow enemies.
Her gentle heart and mysterious nature make her a valuable asset to any team.

features.title: Ice
features.desc: Deals Ice damage and provides shields.

skills.name: Frost Bolt
skills.desc: Deals Ice damage.

skills.name: Icy Shield
skills.desc: Grants a shield to an ally.

skills.name: Blizzard's Blessing
skills.desc: Heals all allies and provides a shield.

skills.name: Guardian Spirit
skills.desc: Increases shield effectiveness.

corin.name: Corin Wickes
corin.title: The Shy Maid
corin.description: A shy maid from Victoria Housekeeping who wields a giant electric saw. Despite her timid nature, she is a formidable stun specialist.
corin.bioSub: "I'm... I'm sorry!" (as she swings her saw)
bioContent: Corin Wickes is a maid of Victoria Housekeeping.
Despite her shy and apologetic demeanor, she is a fearsome stun specialist who wields a giant electric saw.
She is always eager to help, even if she feels nervous about it.

features.title: Electric Saw
features.desc: Wields a giant saw that deals stun damage.

skills.name: Saw Slash
skills.desc: Slash with the saw, dealing Electric damage.

skills.name: Electric Spin
skills.desc: Spins the saw, stunning all nearby enemies.

skills.name: Overdrive
skills.desc: Overcharges the saw, dealing massive Electric damage and stunning all enemies.

skills.name: Shy Strength
skills.desc: Increases stun damage when health is low.

anton.name: Anton Ivanov
anton.title: The Passionate Worker
anton.description: A passionate construction worker from Belobog Industries, Anton fights with a powerful drill that delivers Electric damage and stuns enemies.
bioContent: Anton Ivanov is a construction worker at Belobog Industries.
He fights using a powerful drill that can penetrate enemy defenses and deliver stunning Electric shocks.
His enthusiasm for his work is unmatched, and he brings that same energy to combat.

features.title: Drill
features.desc: Uses a powerful drill to attack and stun.

skills.name: Drill Punch
skills.desc: Strikes with the drill, dealing Electric damage.

skills.name: Overcharge Spin
skills.desc: Spins the drill, dealing AoE Electric damage.

skills.name: Drill Piercer
skills.desc: Unleashes a devastating drill charge that pierces enemy defenses.

skills.name: Worker's Grit
skills.desc: Increases attack speed after each kill.

ben.name: Ben Bigger
ben.title: The Gentle Giant
ben.description: A gentle giant and the accountant of Belobog Industries, Ben uses Fire and defensive abilities to protect his allies.
bioContent: Ben Bigger is the accountant at Belobog Industries.
Though he is a gentle giant, he is a formidable defender who uses Fire and shields to protect his allies.
His kind heart and protective nature make him a beloved member of the team.

skills.name: Fiery Slam
skills.desc: Slams the ground, dealing Fire damage.

skills.name: Protective Wall
skills.desc: Grants a shield to all allies.

skills.name: Bear's Embrace
skills.desc: Provides a massive shield and deals Fire damage to enemies.

skills.name: Accountant's Wisdom
skills.desc: Increases shield strength when allies are low.
